title: Test a populated example in the first-run view
currentProblem: The synthetic repository fixture shows an empty first-run state.

repositoryEvidence.observation: The test fixture renders an empty-state component. This path is synthetic, not an inspected customer repository.

proposedChange: Add an optional example view behind a feature flag without changing authentication or billing.
benefitHypothesis: First useful action may occur sooner. Measure rather than assume.
risks: The example may confuse users who expect an empty project.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing first-run behavior remains available when the flag is off.
A user can clear the example without affecting another workspace.
verificationNeeds: Inspect the real current repository before using this plan.
